lead: A loop-goal.toml acceptance test can name *two* bounds, and splitting it across two `#[test]`s fails the check.
body: A `cargo-named` check matches the test's *name*, so `the_engine_floor_rotates_and_rate_limits_itself` split into `..._rotates` and `..._rate_limits` reads better, passes `cargo test`, and leaves the driver reporting `did not run` forever. Read the `tests = [...]` list before deciding how many functions the work becomes, even when it is two slices and two mechanisms.
